subject: gk
question: How many states were selected in Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA) 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6 states**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **6 states** were selected in the **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA) 2020**.
 
• The states included in the GKRA were **Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Odisha**.
 
• GKRA was launched to boost employment and livelihood opportunities for migrant workers returning to their home states due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The scheme aimed to provide **125 days of employment** to migrant workers across** 116 districts** in these states.
 
• It focused on 25 types of works/activities to be expedited and implemented under 11 different ministries/departments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan** was launched by the Government of India on **20th June 2020**.
 
• The scheme was a part of the government's economic response to the COVID-19 crisis.
 
• It was designed to empower and provide livelihood opportunities in rural areas, particularly for migrant workers affected by the lockdown.
 
• The initiative included a financial outlay of **INR 50,000 crore**.
 
• The program also aimed to create infrastructure and boost the rural economy through the construction of roads, housing, and other public works.
